creator: Northernlion
move: Before playing a card he states what the character needs to have any chance at all, names the damage gap in the deck, and sets a shopping wish for the next store
timing: Reasoning runs ahead of the first consequential play and continues uninterrupted through it
phrasing_shape: needs assessment, gap named, conditional wish for later
aggregate_note: Plan-first narration as the default state; the Coach lane baseline pattern

creator: Northernlion
move: Takes a card that does not fit the current deck and argues the pick out loud against his own objection, on the grounds that specific future enemy types would make it pay off massively
timing: Verdict is delivered after a visible deliberation, before the run moves on
phrasing_shape: pick announced, objection raised, condition that redeems it
aggregate_note: Speculation before testing, with the alternative kept on the record

creator: Northernlion
move: After the worst draw of the run he blames the line they took for making the fight drag, then immediately searches for the salvage line instead of dwelling
timing: Self-blame lands within seconds of the bad draw; recovery talk starts in the same breath
phrasing_shape: cause assigned to own sequencing, instant line search
aggregate_note: Own-the-miss as a reflex, not a ritual

creator: Northernlion
move: Facing heavy incoming damage with no defence drawn, he does the arithmetic out loud, forecasts the next draw, decides the position is mathematically lost, then survives and pivots straight into rest planning for the floor
timing: Numbers are narrated as they are computed; the surprise at surviving lasts one line
phrasing_shape: damage total repeated, draw forecast, flat surprise, next constraint named
aggregate_note: Stakes kept verbally on the table is what makes a card game tense

creator: Northernlion
move: The run dies and he mock-blames the community member whose relic tip he followed at the start, warns himself on mic not to play tilted, then opens the next run on a deliberately riskier path to exploit a new relic
timing: Blame bit runs under thirty seconds; the new plan is stated before the next run's first fight
phrasing_shape: mock accusation at an absent adviser, tilt warning, revised plan
aggregate_note: Failure converts to comedy plus a changed plan; blame is theatre, the adjustment is real

creator: Northernlion
move: Mid-run he poses a genuine rules question to himself, whether two copies of the same power stack, reasons his way to a probable answer, and plays on under the uncertainty without pretending it is settled
timing: The question hangs for roughly ten seconds of reasoning before play resumes
phrasing_shape: open question, probability estimate, play proceeds on the guess
aggregate_note: Uncertainty narrated and worked, not covered; a coachable slot a viewer could answer

creator: Northernlion
move: He announces a speculative combo play in advance as a crazy move, narrates the setup steps as he commits resources to it, and when it lands far weaker than imagined says so plainly and re-plans around the deck he actually has
timing: The gambit is flagged before execution; the disappointment verdict arrives the turn it resolves
phrasing_shape: advance flag, step-by-step commitment, flat letdown verdict
aggregate_note: Announced risk turns a whiff into a shared event instead of a silent mistake

creator: Northernlion
move: After the run-ending death he delivers a full forensic debrief: names the single early relic pick he would reverse, what he should have taken and why, and the two separate problems that one different choice would have solved, then claims the diagnosis itself as the win before the standard sign-off
timing: Debrief runs about fifty seconds, immediately after death, with no reset or filler between
phrasing_shape: counterfactual pick named, two-problem solution, diagnosis framed as the takeaway
aggregate_note: The debrief is the product: a viewer leaves knowing exactly what to nudge next run

creator: CohhCarnage
move: A groupmate tells him the game has deliberately brutal slow-levelling tiers; he interrogates the claim on mic, checks whether he is being trolled, pulls the history out of chat (an old bug kept as a feature), and corrects the feared multiplier down to the real one before accepting it
timing: Several minutes of question-and-answer while play continues underneath; alarm visibly deflates as numbers firm up
phrasing_shape: sceptical question chain, sourced answer, corrected number, settled verdict
aggregate_note: Not-knowing investigated live with the audience as the research department

creator: CohhCarnage
move: His group is short a tank, so he recruits in the open: calls out on stream and in guild, vets applicants by class and level in a sentence or two each, and slots the arrivals in with warm welcomes
timing: Recruitment runs as background process across several minutes of other talk
phrasing_shape: open call, quick vetting questions, welcome on acceptance
aggregate_note: The audience is not watching the group form; the audience is how the group forms

creator: CohhCarnage
move: Chat asks which of the tank classes is better and he gives a structured three-way comparison, axis by axis, names a bottom-line pick, then hedges exactly where his own low level means he is repeating what he has been told
timing: Answer runs about three minutes without stopping play; the hedge lands at the end, not the start
phrasing_shape: question taken seriously, options compared, pick named, experience limit admitted
aggregate_note: Teaching as downtime fill: the slow game is the excuse, the explanation is the content

creator: CohhCarnage
move: Chat warns him that group evacuation spells leave encumbered players behind to die; he works out on mic that his own overloaded character is exactly the one who would be abandoned, states his danger twice as a running gag, and files it as a problem to fix
timing: The new rule is absorbed and personalised within about a minute of hearing it
phrasing_shape: rule absorbed, personal risk named as a joke, consequence spelled out
aggregate_note: Stakes narration aimed at the self: the danger is funny because it is his

creator: CohhCarnage
move: He attacks a shopkeeper by an accidental keypress and is killed by the vendor; he names the mis-key as the cause instantly, waves off the experience-recovery detour when chat suggests it, turns the death into a keybinding lesson for the audience, and resumes selling within the minute
timing: Cause is identified in seconds; the whole failure occupies roughly ninety seconds including the lesson
phrasing_shape: cause named, penalty waved off, lesson extracted for viewers, errand resumed
aggregate_note: Failure dwell near zero: ownership is total precisely because nothing is made of it

creator: CohhCarnage
move: Chat tells him he already owns a haggling skill he has never noticed; he doubts it, checks his ability book on mic, finds it sitting at the threshold, and reacts with open delight before planning to use it
timing: Verification takes under a minute and happens live rather than being taken on trust
phrasing_shape: tip doubted, checked on screen, delight, future plan stated
aggregate_note: Public correction of his own ignorance as a small celebration, not an embarrassment

creator: CohhCarnage
move: During a group fight he narrates the coordination he loves: he is waiting for the other rogue's stun to land before spending his own, so the two crowd-control effects chain instead of overlapping
timing: The appreciation is voiced mid-combat, in the seconds the chain is actually happening
phrasing_shape: partner's move watched for, own move timed to it, pleasure stated
aggregate_note: Lookahead as teamwork: the plan exists because someone else's next move is in it

creator: CohhCarnage
move: A real-life appointment forces him to end the session mid group-search; he apologises for leaving without finding his own replacement, thanks the chat warmly, previews tomorrow's games, and closes by admitting this low-viewer old-school stream is the one he loves doing
timing: Goodbye runs about ninety seconds and is unhurried despite the hard deadline
phrasing_shape: abrupt logistics, apology to the group, gratitude pass, tomorrow tease
aggregate_note: Warmth baseline as the retention mechanism: people are thanked like guests, not metrics
